mica: Quick experiment proposal: two-week PLG push called 'Starter Sparks' — webinar + on-demand snippets + 100 credits + prompt pack. Goal: improve signup->first-generate within 48h by ~20%. :sparkles:

sam: Sounds good. Metric = first-generate within 48h. Tracking via utm_campaign=starter-sparks and events: webinar_signup, credit_claimed, first_generate.

olivia: I'll create the promo flow: webhook -> issue 100 credits -> email with 'Run this sample' CTA. Need promo id and email copy by Thursday noon.

jon: I'll draft two social angles: 1) "Run real prompts now" (developer focus) 2) "Starter templates for teams" (product focus). Also a 1-page benchmark blurb for the blog showing sample latency on our hosted model.

mica: We'll A/B test credit CTA placement: immediate vs after watching 5-min highlight. Keep cohort size ~250 per arm.

event-bot: Webinar scheduled: Starter Sparks A Prompt Pack on 2025-07-02 17:00 UTC. Registration: https://redwood.ai/webinar/starter-sparks

sam: Adding note: exclude corporate domains from auto-credits; send manual sales flag instead.

mica: Great. Sync 9am PT tomorrow for 15m to finalize assets. :thumbsup:
